RoyalTitleDef.label: Squire
RoyalTitleDef.description: A sworn attendant learning the duties of arms and service. The first honor earned in service to the Riverlands. Riverlander titles confer standing, not psychic powers, and never forbid honest work.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Knight
RoyalTitleDef.description: A sworn knight recognized for courage, honorable conduct, and faithful service to the houses of the Riverlands.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Landed Knight
RoyalTitleDef.description: A knight recognized as worthy of a landed household and its duties. This honor grants standing, not a new settlement.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Lord
RoyalTitleDef.description: A recognized head of a Riverlands house, bound to protect its people and honor sworn obligations.

RoyalTitleDef.label: High Lord
RoyalTitleDef.description: A High Lord, also called a Great Lord, commands the respect of lesser houses and carries greater responsibility for the Riverlands.

RoyalTitleDef.label: Lord Paramount
RoyalTitleDef.description: The Riverlands' highest honor, recognizing exceptional leadership and service among its great Houses. It grants your House standing without replacing the Riverlands' ruler or transferring their lands.
